description.value: Sequoia Coastal Coffee is a Vancouver Island-rooted cafe that sources locally produced ingredients to craft coffee drinks, handmade sandwiches, salads, and baked goods celebrating West Coast culture. The Royal Bay location in Colwood operates as a drive-thru, offering a quick, no-fuss stop for cyclists moving through the western Greater Victoria corridor. The brand partners with local suppliers including 2% Jazz coffee and Truffles Catering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms two active Sequoia Coastal Coffee locations: the Royal BC Museum (675 Belleville St, downtown Victoria) and a Drive-Thru at 365A Latoria Blvd, Colwood. The OSM coordinates (48.4059, -123.4952) are roughly 9 km west of downtown Victoria and closely match the Colwood/Royal Bay area, strongly indicating this record corresponds to the Colwood Drive-Thru rather than the museum location. OSM's takeaway=yes tag is corroborated by the website's full takeout menu of beverages, sandwiches, salads, and baked goods; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike racks, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community is tagged 'Victoria' but coordinates (48.4059, -123.4952) place this record in Colwood, matching the Royal Bay Drive-Thru at 365A Latoria Blvd — the community tag appears inaccurate.

Website contains injected third-party spam content (full articles promoting Casino Zeus and EcoPayz Canadian online casinos), suggesting the site has been compromised or is on shared/hacked hosting. Core business content appears legitimate but the site should be flagged.
Two distinct locations exist (Royal BC Museum downtown Victoria; Royal Bay Drive-Thru Colwood); a separate OSM record may exist or be warranted for the museum location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating cafe with confirmed locations and takeout service; a practical refreshment stop for cyclists in the Colwood/western Victoria area.

wow_evidence: Vancouver Island-rooted cafe... two active Sequoia Coastal Coffee locations
